Resolves #19928

The column filter list now draws one even focus ring inside the row, and in neo-dark its rows sit on the menu's surface instead of an olive band. Two token values in the neo list themes and one rule in `Menu.scss`:
- The ring's offset now matches its 3px width, as the legacy themes' 1px ring at -1px already did. This moves every neo-theme list's keyboard ring inside its row; no row moves and no colour changes.
- The value picker's rows take the menu surface. Hover and selection keep the theme's colours.

Change-Class: restoration
Evidence: L2 (a browser e2e on the showcase in both neo themes, red on `dev` `cbd645db61`, green at the head) → L2 required (AC-1..AC-3). Residual: none; AC-4 is the operator's read after merge, listed below.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline `pr-body` and `substrate-size` jobs run in CI.
